name: CreateBoltCoor_8Bolts_3x3
formula: =LAMBDA(spacingX,spacingY,[CenterX],[CenterY],LET(Cx, IF(ISOMITTED(CenterX), 0, CenterX), Cy, IF(ISOMITTED(CenterY), 0, CenterY), bolt_1, HSTACK(-spacingX, spacingY), bolt_2, HSTACK(0, spacingY), bolt_3, HSTACK(spacingX, spacingY), bolt_4, HSTACK(-spacingX, 0), bolt_5, HSTACK(spacingX, 0), bolt_6, HSTACK(-spacingX, -spacingY), bolt_7, HSTACK(0, -spacingY), bolt_8, HSTACK(spacingX, -spacingY), {ref}TranslateCoor(VSTACK(bolt_1, bolt_2, bolt_3, bolt_4, bolt_5, bolt_6, bolt_7, bolt_8), Cx, Cy)))
comment: Returns 8 bolt centers on a 3 by 3 grid with the center omitted. Argument order is spacingX, spacingY, then optional CenterX and CenterY. Order is left to right: top row, middle row without the center, then bottom row. Columns are spacingX apart and rows are spacingY apart. An omitted center coordinate is 0. A non-numeric argument returns #VALUE!. Last Update at 2026-11-03.
